message: Open CodeRabbit thread at 9732ee32 (Minor): planContiguousVerified accepts a short head_sha (box probe: 'abcd1234' lands in plan.land). Downstream compares fail closed, so the result is a false STOP that needs a stop-ack, not a false pass. Follow-up: assert isFullSha(entry.head_sha) when the plan is built.

F5 continuity holds only when --prior is passed. --prior is optional on plan/readback/readback-run/stop-ack, and verify-log against the stale plan-time digest still reports ok/appended after a false->true flip (box probe). The single-merge readback example at :267 omits --prior/--digest-out, while land skill step 12 and step 3 include them. Follow-up: make the doc example consistent, or require --prior once a digest exists.

Architect follow-ups F6 (cached passing row not re-checked against main), F8 (formula-escape compare on verdict_ref) and F9 (free-text stop-ack --by) are still open, as the PR scope states. All three fail closed or are info-level.

Expected effect of the F2 amendment: with patch-id removed as a gate, an empty squash whose PR change already landed on main identically now passes rebased-tree-matches (4833c3dd stopped it as tree-mismatch-patch-id-differs). The content on main still equals the verified intent, so this is not loosening under the amended design. Flagged for the Architect delta gate.
